title: Effects of amyloid-β amyloidosis on axonal pathology in Alzheimer's disease
core_idea: Investigate how Aβ amyloidosis affects axonal pathology in Alzheimer's disease by characterizing Aβ-related axonal phenotypes using histochemistry, immunohistochemistry, and fluorescence imaging.
tldr: Aim to characterize Aβ-related axonal phenotypes in AD brains to understand how amyloid-β amyloidosis impacts axons.
